newJobs.descriptionText: About TailorCare TailorCare is transforming the experience of specialty care. Our comprehensive care program takes a deeply personal, evidence-based approach to improving patient outcomes for joint, back, and muscle conditions. By combining a careful assessment of patients’ symptoms, health histories, preferences, and goals with predictive data and latest evidence-based guidelines, we help patients choose—and navigate—the most effective treatment pathway for them, every step of the way. TailorCare values the experiences and perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds. We are a highly collaborative, curious, and determined team passionate about scaling a high-growth start-up to improve the lives of those in pain. TailorCare is a remote-first company with a hybrid office in Nashville. About the Role We are seeking a Senior Product Manager to lead our Patient Experience Platform. In this role, you will own the end-to-end digital experience for TailorCare patients across their care journey, from onboarding and intake through engagement, adherence, and outcomes. You will be responsible for defining the product vision and strategy for TailorCare’s patient-facing applications, ensuring we deliver intuitive, engaging, and clinically meaningful experiences at scale. This role sits at the intersection of product, clinical care, and growth, and plays a critical role in driving patient activation, satisfaction, and long-term outcomes. You will partner closely with care teams, design, engineering, data science to ship consumer-grade healthcare experiences that are trusted, empathetic, and outcome-driven. Key Responsibilities Own the product vision and roadmap for TailorCare’s patient-facing platforms (web and mobile). Translate patient needs, clinical goals, and business priorities into high-impact product initiatives and features. Drive discovery through patient research, usability testing, data analysis, and direct patient feedback. Help design and deliver end-to-end patient journeys (onboarding, intake, education, triage, engagement, adherence). Partner with clinical and operations teams to ensure digital experiences align with real-world care workflows. Collaborate with design and engineering to build delightful, accessible, and scalable B2C products. Define success metrics (activation, engagement, conversion, retention, outcomes) and continuously optimize. Incorporate AI-powered and personalization features to improve patient guidance and care navigation. Serve as the connective tissue across product, clinical, and development teams to ensure cohesive execution. Key Qualifications 5+ years of product management experience, with significant ownership of B2C or patient-facing products. 3+ years experience in healthcare, digital health, or regulated consumer platforms. Proven experience launching and scaling consumer-grade applications (mobile and/or web). Strong understanding of patient journeys, engagement mechanics, and behavior change. Experience working closely with designers on UX, usability, and accessibility. Data-driven mindset with ability to define metrics, run experiments, and interpret insights. Comfortable operating in ambiguous problem spaces and turning loose concepts into shipped products. Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills. Bachelor’s degree required; clinical or health-related background is a plus. What's In It For You Meaningful Work: We are dedicated to our mission and deeply value our patients and each other. Each day offers the opportunity to make a positive impact. Work Environment: We operate as a remote-first company with options for a hybrid work model in Nashville. Time Off: Our generous paid time off (PTO) and holiday plans ensure you have ample time to rest and recharge. Family First: We offer paid parental leave and support a healthy work-life balance, encouraging flexibility and autonomy. We love talking about our family and pets! Comprehensive Benefits: From Day 1, employees enjoy medical, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, wellness resources and an employer HSA contribution. Fair Compensation: We are committed to equitable pay for all team members and support your future goals with a 401k plan that includes employer matching. Community: We foster an inclusive environment where you can rely on your teammates, share honest feedback, and feel comfortable being your authentic self at work each day. Compile’s data includes high capture medical and pharmacy claims, closed capture Medicare claims (100%), along with best-in-class provider affiliations and customer master. At McKesson we deliver careers with purpose and potential. Our focus on better health starts with creating an inclusive environment with strong values where you can build a fulfilling career. You can count on us to provide you with resources and opportunities to grow and be your best, while contributing to our pursuit of improving lives. The Sr. Associate QA Automation Engineer is responsible for developing and executing manual and automated testing activities across Ontada's product ecosystem, including AI-enabled and GenAI-powered solutions. Working under the guidance of senior engineers and QA leads, the engineer will contribute to validating web applications, APIs, backend services, data workflows, and AI-driven features to ensure high levels of product quality, reliability, and performance. This role partners closely with Product Managers, Software Engineers, and Operations teams to support the delivery of secure, scalable, and customer-focused healthcare technology solutions. Key Responsibilities Quality Engineering Ownership & Execution Execute test plans and test cases for assigned features and product modules. Participate in requirement reviews and contribute to test scenario identification. Identify and document defects with clear reproduction steps and supporting evidence. Perform functional, integration, regression, and exploratory testing. Support release validation activities across multiple environments. Test Automation & Framework Development Develop and maintain automated test scripts for UI, API, and service-layer testing. Contribute to existing automation frameworks using tools such as Selenium, Playwright, TOSCA, or equivalent technologies. Develop and execute API automation tests using tools such as Postman, RestAssured, or similar frameworks. Support integration of automation suites into CI/CD pipelines. Utilize AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot or similar tools to improve productivity and test coverage. AI / GenAI Quality Engineering Assist in validating AI-enabled and GenAI-powered product features. Participate in testing prompt-based workflows and AI-generated responses. Support validation activities focused on response accuracy, consistency, and reliability. Execute predefined test scenarios covering prompt variations and edge cases. Develop familiarity with concepts such as LLMs, prompts, RAG, AI agents, and guardrails. Utilize AI-powered tools to assist with test scenario generation and exploratory testing. Backend & Data Testing Perform backend testing using SQL and/or NoSQL data systems. Validate data ingestion, transformations, persistence, and integrity across services and environments. Assist with testing asynchronous workflows and integrations (e.g., message queues, APIs, batch processes). Agile Collaboration Collaborate with developers, business analysts, and product owners throughout the development lifecycle. Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, grooming, reviews, and retrospectives. Support shift-left testing practices by engaging early in feature development. Quality Governance, Compliance & Continuous Improvement Contribute audit‑ready documentation, including test plans, execution evidence, and reports. Participate in root‑cause discussions for quality issues and contribute to corrective actions. Identify opportunities for improving QA processes, tools, and documentation; contribute suggestions through established continuous improvement channels. Research and evaluate new QA, automation, or performance testing, AI assisted tools and techniques as appropriate. Minimum Requirement Degree or equivalent and typically requires 2+ years of relevant experience. Education Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Engineering, Mathematics, or equivalent practical experience. Critical Skills 2+ years of Software Quality Assurance experience. 2+ years of hands-on test automation experience. Experience with at least one automation framework such as Selenium, Playwright, Cypress, or TOSCA. Experience with API testing using Postman, RestAssured, or equivalent tools. Proficiency in Java, Python, or JavaScript. Experience working in Agile development environments. Basic understanding of CI/CD concepts and tools such as Jenkins or GitHub Actions. Experience with SQL for backend validation and data testing. Familiarity with Git-based source control systems. Additional Skills: Exposure to AI/GenAI testing concepts. Experience testing LLM-powered or AI-enabled applications. Understanding of prompt engineering and prompt validation. Familiarity with RAG architectures and AI evaluation techniques. Knowledge of healthcare technology or regulated environments. Experience with cloud platforms such as Azure, AWS, or GCP. Working Conditions Full-time in office role based in Bangalore, India (IST). Collaboration with distributed, cross‑functional teams. newJobs.descriptionText: Huron is a global consultancy that collaborates with clients to drive strategic growth, ignite innovation and navigate constant change. Through a combination of strategy, expertise and creativity, we help clients accelerate operational, digital and cultural transformation, enabling the change they need to own their future. Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future. At Huron, you have the opportunity to discover your professional passions by being an integral part of our teams and getting exposure to a variety of projects. Our Analysts join us from a wide range of backgrounds and have immediate access to the training and coaching they need to drive impact and develop into the innovators and leaders of tomorrow. We provide the opportunity to enhance analytical skills while working as part of a team committed to developing creative insights, implementing processes, and driving tangible results. Our Analysts work independently and in group settings to get hands on experience in building effective relationships and creating solutions for our clients. Health systems, academic medical centers, and other healthcare provider organizations are all trying to address a common enterprise problem: our data should be telling us more than it is, so what is in the way, and how can we develop a data-driven, AI-enabled approach to our mission? Our Assessments team answers that question. We go into an organization, map how data moves and where it stalls, quantify what the friction costs, and hand leadership a case for change they can act on and fund. As a Senior Analyst you sit at the center of that work. You will support current-state analysis, build the value stream maps that make bottlenecks visible, size the gap between where a client is and where they need to be, and translate client needs into strategy roadmaps an executive committee can approve. You will work within a broader assessment team to develop future state vision statements and develop executable roadmaps Role Responsibilities Include Analyzing data, synthesizing documentation, developing value stream maps, drafting future state process designs. Synthesizing client stakeholder interviews, identifying process improvement opportunities Developing recommendations, building business cases, defining return on investment (ROI) for proposed data management modernization initiatives. Developing executive summaries in PowerPoint & Word Analyzing client documentation in Excel Development of reports, dashboards, and visualizations as needed in Power BI ­ Qualifications 1+ years of work experience in consulting, healthcare, or financial analysis 1+ years of experience using BI & Visualization tools such as Oracle Analytics Cloud, Tableau or Power BI 1+ years of experience with SQL programming. 1+ years of experience working with data sources such as Databases, Data Lakes or Cloud Applications. Bachelor's Degree in Business, Computer Science/Management or Information Systems or equivalent Additional Preferred Skill Requirements: Familiarity with Enterprise data platforms such as Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake. Data Engineering experience a major plus. Has strong presentation and collaborative skills and can communicate all aspects of the job requirements, including the creation of formal documentation /deliverables Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Excellent organizational, time-management, and communication skills Experience with project management and/or software implementation process Excellent verbal and written communication skills Strong interpersonal skills in working with clients and co-workers Strong client management skills Willingness to travel up to 50% (project dependent) The estimated base salary for this job is $85,000 - $95,000. The range represents a good faith estimate of the range that Huron reasonably expects to pay for this job at the time of the job posting. The actual salary paid to an individual will vary based on multiple factors, including but not limited to specific skills or certifications, years of experience, market changes, and required travel. This job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s annual incentive compensation program, which reflects Huron’s pay for performance philosophy. Inclusive of annual incentive compensation opportunity, the total estimated compensation range for this job is $93,500 - $104,500. The job is also eligible to participate in Huron’s benefit plans which include medical, dental and vision coverage and other wellness programs. The salary range information provided is in accordance with applicable state and local laws regarding salary transparency that are currently in effect and may be implemented in the future. newJobs.descriptionText: 1Password is growing. We’ve surpassed $400M in ARR and we’re continuing to accelerate, earning a spot on the Forbes Cloud 100 for four years in a row and teaming up with iconic partners like Oracle Red Bull Racing. About 1Password At 1Password, we’re building the foundation for a safe, productive digital future. Our mission is to unleash employee productivity without compromising security by ensuring every identity is authentic, every application sign-in is secure, and every device is trusted. We innovated the market-leading enterprise password manager and pioneered Unified Access Management, a new cybersecurity category built for the way people and AI agents work today. As one of the most loved brands in cybersecurity, we take a human-centric approach in everything from product strategy to user experience. Over 180,000 businesses, from Fortune 100 leaders to the world’s most innovative AI companies, trust 1Password to help their teams securely adopt the SaaS and AI tools they need to do their best work. If you're excited about the opportunity to contribute to the digital safety of millions, to work alongside a team of curious, driven individuals, and to solve hard problems in a fast-paced, dynamic environment, then we want to hear from you. Come join us and help shape a safer, simpler digital future. How we’re using AI today Our Engineering, Product, and Design teams are thoughtfully integrating AI across the full software and product development lifecycle to move faster without sacrificing quality or security. In practice, that looks like engineers using AI-assisted coding tools to accelerate reviews and catch bugs earlier, product managers synthesizing user research at scale, and designers rapidly prototyping and iterating with AI-generated mockups. We approach AI the same way we approach security: with clear principles, human accountability at every consequential decision point, and rigorous evaluation before anything ships to customers. As part of the SaaS Manager https://1password.com/product/saas-manager team, you'll be building the platform that IT and Security teams rely on to discover, govern, and optimize their AI and SaaS ecosystems (work that just earned 1Password recognition as a Leader in the 2026 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for SaaS Management Platforms). You'll work on real problems: uncontrolled AI spend, shadow IT, SaaS sprawl, and the complex access lifecycles that come with it. Following 1Password's acquisition of Trelica in early 2025 https://blog.1password.com/1password-acquires-trelica/, you'll join a collaborative team with a startup mindset backed by the resources and mission of one of the most trusted names in security. As we scale the platform to meet our enterprise-scale ambitions, you'll help shape not just what we build, but how we build it. We are hiring a Senior Developer who can go deep on complex problems and come up for air to bring their team with them; someone who ships high-quality work with a high degree of independence, champions technical excellence within their team, and makes the engineers around them better in the process. This is a remote opportunity within Canada and the US, ideally with the ability to work within Eastern Time hours. You share your reasoning in a way that helps others grow. - You communicate well across technical and non-technical contexts: you can write a clear design doc, facilitate a productive engineering discussion, and explain a hard problem to a partner without losing the plot. - You have a practical, curious approach to agentic AI in the software development lifecycle: you use it where it creates real leverage in your own work, form opinions about what's actually useful, and share what you learn with your team without needing to be prompted - You're a strong mentor: you guide less experienced developers through pair programming, code review feedback, and technical conversations, and you do it in a way that builds their confidence and independence over time WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT: - Own the design and delivery of complex features end-to-end, from initial scoping through production, with minimal guidance and a high standard for what "done" means - Contribute to and lead technical design discussions within your team: write clear design documents, surface risks early, propose solutions, and build consensus around the right approach - Set and uphold best practices within the team (e.g. testing strategies, code quality norms, observability standards, etc.) and make sure they stick through code reviews and hands-on involvement. - Partner closely with product managers and designers to understand the customer problems behind the work, advocate for sound engineering, and help the team make good tradeoffs - Bring a practical, hands-on perspective on where agentic AI tools create genuine leverage in your own workflow and share what works with your teammates BONUS POINTS FOR: - Experience evolving a legacy or growth-stage application into an enterprise-scale platform - Comfort across a wide range of technical stacks (.NET/C#, MongoDB, Go, Rust, TypeScript, React, and others); newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. A Little About Us Yahoo is made up of several organizations, each led by a GM and focused on driving key product lines. This role sits within the Yahoo Mail group, home to our flagship product, Yahoo Mail. You’ll be joining a team — that has a great product line, with its 4.5+ star app experiences, strong business foundation, and robust technology, is well-positioned in the consumer communication space. Now, we’re entering our next chapter: building the most consumer-focused platform for managing the “business of life,” through email and beyond. You’ll join a team of engineers dedicated to delivering the best consumer mail experience, meticulously refining every detail to make that vision a reality. A Lot About You You’re an experienced engineering leader who loves building and empowering teams to create and maintain products that delight millions of users. You’re passionate about high-quality application development, technology stack, and the cloud - and you take pride in seeing your teams deliver great consumer experiences at scale. You know how to balance big-picture vision with hands-on leadership - guiding teams to think deeply about users, scenarios, and edge cases, while driving projects to successful completion. You lead with empathy and curiosity, create a culture of growth and collaboration, and understand the broader impact of great engineering on both people and the business. Define and execute the engineering vision, strategy, and roadmap, aligning technical investments with product priorities, business objectives, and long-term platform evolution. Drive AI-native software development practices across the organization, leveraging AI-powered tools, agents, automation, and modern engineering workflows to improve productivity, quality, and speed of execution. Lead AI transformation initiatives that reimagine how products are built, operated, and experienced, creating measurable value for users, developers, and the business. Partner closely with Product, Design, Data Science, and business leaders to identify, prioritize, and deliver innovative AI-powered customer experiences that differentiate Yahoo Mail in the market. Foster a culture of technical excellence, customer obsession, experimentation, and continuous learning while attracting, developing, and retaining top engineering talent. Stay at the forefront of emerging technologies and AI advancements, guiding architectural decisions, technical reviews, and strategic investments that enable scalable and responsible innovation. Qualifications: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 10+ years of experience building and delivering large-scale consumer software products, with at least 5+ years leading multiple engineering teams and engineering managers. Proven success leading engineering organizations that consistently deliver high-quality products while balancing innovation, execution, operational excellence, and business outcomes. Experience leading AI-native product organizations or large-scale AI transformation programs within consumer technology companies. Demonstrated experience operating in an AI-native development environment and leveraging modern AI technologies, copilots, agents, and automation to transform engineering workflows. Proven track record leading AI transformation initiatives that have delivered measurable improvements in developer productivity, customer experience, operational efficiency, or business performance. Strong technical expertise in modern application development, distributed systems, cloud-native architectures, mobile and web platforms, and scalable software design. Hands-on experience with object-oriented programming languages such as Java, Kotlin, Swift, or similar technologies, with the ability to engage deeply in technical discussions and architectural decisions. Experience integrating Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), machine learning capabilities, or intelligent agent systems into products, platforms, or engineering processes. Strong business acumen with the ability to identify and prioritize opportunities where AI can create competitive advantage, accelerate growth, improve customer engagement, and unlock operational efficiencies. Exceptional leadership, communication, and organizational skills, with demonstrated ability to influence across functions, drive organizational change, and build high-performing, inclusive teams in fast-paced environments. Preferred Qualifications: Experience building, scaling, or modernizing email, messaging, communications, or productivity platforms serving millions of users. Recognized thought leadership in AI strategy, engineering productivity, platform modernization, or organizational transformation. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Here, we focus on the health, happiness, and well-being of you and those we serve – we care. What you do at McKesson matters. If you want to be part of tomorrow’s health today, we want to hear from you. Rx Savings Solutions (RxSS), part of McKesson’s CoverMyMeds prescription technologies business segment, offers an innovative patented software system that educates and empowers consumers to make the best healthcare choices at the lowest cost. Founded and operated by a team of pharmacists and software engineers, we support a collaborative, cost-saving solution for purchasing prescription drugs. The Clinical Pharmacist - Sales primarily serves business development as a Clinical Pharmacist on the Clinical Advisory Team responsible for providing clinical and industry expertise to the Sales (Employer, Health Plan, Consultant/Broker, State/Local Government) team. The Clinical Pharmacist also provides industry guidance and support to the Revenue Demand Generation team as needed. This is a client facing role requiring skills that leverage clinical expertise, knowledge of competitive landscape, strategic thinking, quantitative analysis, and a clear understanding of key business objectives. This role requires up to 35% business travel and is primarily office-based in Overland Park, Kansas. newJobs.descriptionText: It takes powerful technology to connect our brands and partners with an audience of hundreds of millions of people. Whether you’re looking to write mobile app code, engineer the servers behind our massive ad tech stacks, or develop algorithms to help us process trillions of data points a day, what you do here will have a huge impact on our business—and the world. About the Team Identity platforms at Yahoo provide modern, secure identity offerings for consumers and businesses interacting with Yahoo systems. These platforms operate at massive scale, serving hundreds of millions of users every day, and power critical authentication, authorization, and account management capabilities across Yahoo products. As part of Yahoo’s transition to an AI-First engineering model, teams increasingly leverage AI-assisted development environments (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) combined with Spec-Driven Development (SDD) workflows, to accelerate delivery while maintaining high engineering quality. About the Role We are looking for a Full Stack Software Dev Engineer II to join our Identity organization. You will work across the stack to build secure, scalable, and user-friendly authentication and account management experiences that serve hundreds of millions of users globally. In this role, you will work independently with minimal guidance, owning critical features and acting as a technical resource for your peers. A core expectation is the ability to collaborate effectively with AI systems—using structured specs, deep codebase context, and prompt modeling to guide high-quality software implementation. We seek engineers who possess an experimentation-forward mindset and view AI as a force multiplier for architectural excellence and team-wide productivity. Responsibilities Design, build, and operate secure, scalable full-stack identity systems using ReactJS, TypeScript, Java, and Node.js. Own complex features and standalone project phases end-to-end, from gathering requirements and systems design to implementation, testing, and production. Lead an AI-first development workflow within the squad, writing precise markdown specifications to drive AI-assisted code generation (Cursor, Claude Code), and taking responsibility for the rigorous validation, testing, and safety of all generated assets. Identify system bottlenecks, enhance platform reliability, and debug complex production issues in our high-traffic distributed identity systems. Proactively research and implement AI-driven efficiencies in your daily coding workflows, replacing repetitive manual tasks with structured automation, custom templates, and AI-assisted testing. Act as a technical resource for the team by sharing successful prompt engineering patterns, context modeling strategies, and workflow optimizations that level up the overall engineering velocity of the squad. Collaborate cross-functionally with Product Managers, UX Designers, Security Engineers, and other Yahoo product squads to coordinate technical integrations. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. 4–6 years of professional full-stack software engineering experience. Strong hands-on engineering experience using Java for robust backend services. Experience building responsive, high-performance web applications using React.js, Node.js, JavaScript/TypeScript, and modern frameworks such as Next.js. Strong core engineering fundamentals in distributed system design, API development, databases, and web security. Demonstrated experience integrating AI-assisted developer tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot) into day-to-day software development workflows to build and refactor production-grade systems. Practical understanding of prompt engineering, model limitations, and structured context assembly to generate robust code outputs. Proven capability to evaluate, audit, and debug AI-generated outputs, ensuring alignment with Yahoo’s high standards for code quality, security protocols, and performance. Experience with testing frameworks, CI/CD pipelines, and writing production-ready, highly maintainable tests. Preferred Qualifications Experience building or maintaining high-scale Identity and Access Management (IAM) systems, auth protocols (OAuth, OIDC, SAML), or web security standards. Cloud platform experience (GCP, AWS, or Azure) and infrastructure-as-code. Familiarity with observability tools (Splunk, Grafana) and client/server performance profiling. Experience with structured development methodologies, such as Spec-Driven Development (SDD), API-first design, or AI-assisted diagnostic tools. Exposure to web accessibility (WCAG), internationalization, or large-scale consumer product delivery. What Success Looks Like Consistently deliver high-quality, high-impact features independently, ensuring secure user authentication experiences for hundreds of millions of users. Masterfully leverage AI-assisted tools to significantly compress development lifecycles while maintaining an ultra-high bar for security compliance and test coverage. Raise overall engineering standards by contributing to system architecture discussions, documenting clear technical specifications, and mentoring junior engineers. Accelerate squad velocity by sharing innovative, repeatable ways to integrate AI workflows into daily development, testing, and troubleshooting activities. newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. A Little About Us Yahoo Mail AntiSpam and Delivery Engineering powers the core intelligence and transmission infrastructure for over 220 million active users worldwide. AntiSpam Engineering builds high-throughput, real-time protection systems that shield users from spam, phishing, fraud, and abuse using advanced machine learning algorithms and agentic AI detection. Delivery Engineering manages high-performing, resilient distributed systems that deliver billions of outbound and inbound messages daily across web services, email RFCs, and global networking layers. We operate at a massive scale—handling billions of daily connections and managing petabytes of storage. As we modernize our stack toward cloud-native architecture (GCP), we are actively embedding agentic AI and AI-assisted workflows into our daily engineering culture. About the Role As a Senior Software Engineer (IC4) on the AntiSpam and Delivery team, you will drive technical solutions across high-volume spam detection, entity reputation, traffic shaping, and email delivery pipelines. At IC4, you are expected to operate with autonomy—translating ambiguous requirements into resilient architectures, performing root-cause analysis on critical systems, making key design decisions, and elevating team productivity through technical leadership and AI-assisted engineering practices. Your scope directly impacts your squad and the reliability of Yahoo Mail's infrastructure. Key Responsibilities Architect, build, and maintain high-concurrency, distributed microservices in Java and Go that meet stringent SLA, reliability, and security constraints. Champion AI-assisted engineering practices on the team, leveraging tools like Claude, GitHub Copilot and Cursor to accelerate feature implementation, code refactoring, and automated test suite creation. Integrate agentic AI workflows and LLM capabilities to enhance real-time spam detection models, abuse pattern recognition, and automated root-cause diagnostics. Lead technical initiatives across the squad, driving architecture reviews, code quality standards, and continuous deployment to production. Automate infrastructure provisioning, scaling, CI/CD pipelines, and telemetry monitoring across cloud-native (GCP) and hybrid environments. B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Hands-on proficiency with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude, GitHub Copilot, Cursor) to accelerate coding, debugging, and system optimization. Strong computer science fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, operating systems, and distributed networking. Proven experience building and deploying cloud-native applications (preferably in GCP or AWS) with CI/CD automation. Demonstrated ability to lead technical initiatives, guide architectural choices, and mentor engineering peers. Preferred Qualifications Operational experience managing high-throughput, fault-tolerant distributed systems under strict low-latency requirements. Experience with prompt engineering, agentic AI frameworks, or integrating LLM APIs into production pipelines and developer tools. Experience with big data and stream processing technologies (e.g., Hadoop, Spark, Kafka, HBase). Background in anti-spam, anti-abuse, text classification, or anomaly detection systems will be a plus. Working knowledge of scripting languages (e.g., Python) for data analysis and pipeline automation. You will lead the development of both first-party and third-party games, owning the strategy and execution required to build a compelling, sustainable portfolio. This includes shaping new game concepts, partnering with internal and external developers, and continuously optimizing performance through data, experimentation, and player insight. You will also play a key role in driving user experience research (UXR)—developing a deep understanding of player behavior, motivations, and market trends, and translating those insights into product decisions that improve engagement, retention, and overall player experience. In addition to games, you will collaborate with our discovery and platform teams to ensure strong alignment to improve how users find and engage with games and platform features that reinforce retention and repeat play. You are equally comfortable thinking strategically and executing day-to-day. You bring a strong understanding of game systems, player behavior, and live operations, and you use data, UXR, and experimentation to drive outcomes. You are also excited about leveraging AI tools and technologies to improve product development, enhance workflows, and unlock new opportunities across gameplay, personalization, and content creation. Lead the development and launch of first-party games, third-party integrations, and supporting platform features. Partner with Game Design, Engineering, Product Design, Analytics, and Production to deliver high-quality, engaging game experiences. Drive user experience research (UXR) efforts, leveraging player data, playtests, and market insights to inform product decisions. Architect AI-augmented dashboards and reporting structures to track KPIs and generate actionable insights. Define and prioritize product requirements, balancing user impact, business goals, and technical constraints. Lead Agile development processes, ensuring consistent delivery and iteration toward long-term goals. Collaborate with external partners and developers to source, evaluate, and integrate third-party content. Identify and implement AI-driven efficiencies and tools to enhance the product development lifecycle, experimentation, reporting and team productivity. Stay current on trends in gaming, AI, and consumer product development to inform strategy and innovation. You Must Have 5+ years of experience as a Product Manager, with a focus on consumer-facing products. Experience building or managing casual games on web or mobile platforms. Proven track record of leading products from concept to launch and iteration. Deep understanding of game systems, player behavior, and engagement/retention mechanics. Experience working cross-functionally with engineering, design, and analytics teams. Strong analytical skills and experience using data to inform decisions and prioritize work. Experience with A/B testing, experimentation frameworks, and performance optimization. Experience managing external partners or third-party integrations. Strong communication and stakeholder management skills. Experience using AI tools (e.g., for analysis, prototyping, content generation, or development workflows) and a willingness to incorporate AI into product thinking and execution. Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a fast-paced, iterative environment. Strong judgment in evaluating AI-generated outputs and validating data integrity to ensure high-quality product decision-making. newJobs.descriptionText: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry’s digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. Xometry is looking for a Principal Software Engineer to join our Partner Ecosystems team. This team builds the high-performance integration layer that embeds Xometry’s AI-native marketplace directly into the world’s leading CAD and PLM platforms. You will be the primary technical architect for our landmark partnership with a major enterprise partner. This is not a standard plug-in project; you will be responsible for extracting Xometry’s core AI engines (DFM and IQE) and natively embedding them into our partner's core digital ecosystems. Your work will enable a "science fiction speed" workflow where designers receive real-time manufacturability and pricing feedback on native 3D geometry without ever leaving their primary design environment. This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location. How You'll Contribute: Software Development and Technical Craft: You will lead the discovery, architectural design, and adoption of our flagship embedded partner integration. You'll introduce best practices for handling native 3D geometry data flows and ensure our systems are extensible, scalable, and capable of delivering real-time AI insights at the moment of design. AI Fluency: You will leverage AI tools to accelerate the development of geometry-processing pipelines and collaborate with our Data Science team to ensure the "IQE" (Instant Quoting) engine performs with sub-second latency within the partner application UI. In addition, you’ll define and evangelize the organization's AI fluency standards, coaching Staff and Senior engineers on integrating AI tooling into architecture, design, and development workflows to drive measurable productivity and quality outcomes. Problem Solving and Decision Making: You will tackle complex issues involving deep technical coupling between Xometry’s marketplace and our partner's enterprise software environment. You'll exercise judgment in selecting the right methods for ring-fenced data governance and "one-click" order placement within enterprise-grade security constraints. Scope and Impact: You are responsible for leading cross-team decision-making and executing multi-quarter roadmaps. Your work directly impacts Xometry’s strategic edge, moving us from lightweight HTML snippets to a deep, native integration that eliminates the need for design file exports. Collaboration and Communication: You will act as the primary technical point of contact for our partner's engineering teams. You'll motivate internal Xometry teams to embrace the vision of a "unified digital thread" and mentor senior and mid-level engineers through complex design reviews. Operational Excellence: You will own the reliability and security of the integration microservices, ensuring that "click-to-buy" functionality is bulletproof and that monitoring/alerting covers the unique lifecycle of enterprise PLM transactions. newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. About the Role We are looking for a Principal Product Manager, Client Platforms for Yahoo Mail, to lead the product strategy and execution for Yahoo Mail’s client platforms and shared technology integrations. This role owns the horizontal capabilities that power Yahoo Mail experiences across all platforms, including authentication, identity, privacy, security, and foundational client frameworks. This is a senior, highly cross-functional role that works deeply with application engineering teams, experience-focused product managers, and central platform and infrastructure teams. You will be responsible for ensuring that Yahoo Mail clients remain secure, compliant, scalable, and adaptable as the product ecosystem evolves. A critical dimension of this role is guiding Yahoo Mail through large-scale platform transitions and service realignments, ensuring continuity for users and partners while enabling independent execution across multiple organizations. This work requires strong systems thinking, excellent stakeholder management, and comfort operating in complex commercial and technical environments. What You’ll Do Own the product vision and roadmap for Yahoo Mail’s client platforms and shared services across web, iOS, Android, and emerging surfaces. Define and shape the strategic roadmaps for Yahoo Mail client platforms, including decisions around codebases, architectural patterns, and technology investments that enable long-term scalability and maintainability. Partner closely with application engineering teams to ensure client platforms are built and operated in a cost-efficient manner, balancing performance, developer velocity, and operational complexity. Drive adoption of modern technologies and platform capabilities to deliver fast, reliable, and secure user experiences across all clients. Partner with AI and platform teams to enable client-side support for AI-powered experiences, ensuring Yahoo Mail clients can securely and efficiently integrate capabilities such as intelligent assistance, personalization, and emerging AI-driven features. Lead cross-platform initiatives spanning authentication, identity, privacy, security, and compliance, in close collaboration with central platform teams. Act as the connective tissue between client engineering, experience-focused product managers, and backend platform teams, ensuring cohesive end-to-end execution. Drive platform consistency while enabling differentiated experiences across clients where appropriate. Lead complex platform transitions, service separations, and long-running partner support programs that require coordination across multiple teams, organizations, and external stakeholders. Ensure client platforms are resilient to organizational change, capable of operating independently where required, and aligned with long-term commercial, legal, and regulatory constraints. Represent Yahoo Mail in executive-level discussions related to platform strategy, technical risk, timelines, and tradeoffs. Define and track success metrics across performance, security posture, reliability, cost efficiency, and developer productivity, using data to guide prioritization and investment decisions. What We’re Looking For Experience: 10+ years of product management experience, with significant ownership of platforms, infrastructure-adjacent products, or large-scale client systems. Experience building and operating consumer applications at scale is strongly preferred. Direct experience with email platforms or messaging systems is a strong plus, given the unique technical, operational, and trust challenges of email. Application Platform Leadership: Proven ability to define and evolve shared capabilities used by many teams, balancing consistency with flexibility while keeping end users and business customers connected through reliable, scalable platforms. Technical Depth: Strong technical fluency across client architectures, authentication and identity systems, privacy and security controls, and platform integrations. Familiarity with the complexity and constraints of email ecosystems (deliverability, trust, abuse prevention, identity, and standards) is highly valued. Complex Program Ownership: Demonstrated success leading ambiguous, multi-year initiatives involving multiple stakeholders, external dependencies, and contractual considerations, while maintaining operational stability and user trust. Stakeholder Management: Exceptional ability to align engineering, legal, privacy, security, commercial, and executive stakeholders around a common plan, particularly in environments where platforms serve both consumers and enterprise partners. Product Judgment: Strong instincts for risk management, sequencing, and tradeoffs in high-impact, high-visibility environments, with a focus on protecting user trust and long-term platform health. Communication: Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical, organizational, and platform concepts to senior audiences. Mission & Product Mindset: A genuine interest in building products that empower people in their day-to-day lives, with an appreciation for email as a vital, enduring communications tool that continues to have real-world impact at a global scale Your Day-to-Day Partner with client and platform engineering leaders to translate strategic goals into executable roadmaps. Collaborate with experienced product managers to ensure platform capabilities enable high-quality user experiences across all clients. Work closely with identity, authentication, privacy, and security teams to ensure compliant and secure implementations. Lead planning and execution for major platform changes, transitions, and long-term initiatives. Identify risks early, drive alignment on mitigation strategies, and keep senior leadership informed. Serve as a trusted product leader for some of the most complex and foundational work within Yahoo Mail. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

We provide products and services to help each product enable use cases faster and cost-effectively. Proven track record of mentoring and leveling up other engineers, influencing engineering culture, and establishing best practices across a team or organization (e.g., design standards, testing strategy, observability, operational excellence). Your ideas and solutions have the potential to reach millions of customers as we work together to write the next chapter in our history. Come build with us and take your career to new heights. We’re solving problems and advancing the manufacturing trade through innovative technology and our Industry 4.0 Initiative. We are committed to ensuring our state-of-the-art “smart factory” products and services provide greater quality to our customers & greater environmental and social value to our planet. We are unique in that we have a rich and storied history dating back to 1843, but that hasn't stopped us from evolving into a vibrant, diverse, global growth company. Global Benefits & Perks You’ll be rewarded with a competitive salary plus receive entitlements and benefits unique to your country of hire. Diverse & Inclusive Culture: We pride ourselves on being an awesome place to work. We respect and embrace differences because that’s how the best work gets done. You’ll find we like to have fun here, too. Purpose-Driven Company: You’ll help us continue to make positive changes in the local communities where we work and live as well as in the broader world through volunteerism, giving back and sustainable business practices.

Job Summary: McKesson’s temperature controlled automated Distribution Center is currently hiring a Facility Maintenance Service Technician. This is a chance to work for a company that touches virtually every aspect of healthcare. This position involves ensuring the safe, efficient, and reliable operation of the distribution center facility by monitoring building systems, conducting routine inspections, and coordinating maintenance activities. This individual will evaluate facility needs, recommend improvements to optimize space utilization, and support uninterrupted operations through proactive facility management and maintenance practices. What You'll Need The ideal candidate will have experience maintaining and repairing equipment in a distribution center, manufacturing, or industrial environment, along with strong troubleshooting skills, a commitment to safety, and the ability to work effectively with employees at all levels. Qualifications include: Facility maintenance, maintenance technician, or service technician experience. Experience troubleshooting, diagnosing, and repairing a variety of equipment used in a distribution center environment. Knowledge of and ability to safely operate maintenance-related tools and equipment, including hand tools, power tools, conveyors, forklifts, pressure gauges, voltmeters, and similar equipment. Basic knowledge of warehouse operations and distribution center environments. Exposure to multiple maintenance and skilled trades, including mechanical, electrical, and facility systems. Strong communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally with frontline employees, vendors, and leadership teams. Demonstrated ability to quickly learn new equipment, technologies, and conveyance systems. Working knowledge of Lockout/Tagout (LOTO) procedures and OSHA safety standards. Physical Requirements: Ability to lift and carry up to 50 lbs. Includes standing, sitting, walking, general labor, ladder, scissor lift & fork truck use, climbing up to (4) story heights in a warehouse environment. MMS distributes medical-surgical supplies, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic equipment and supplies, along with other solutions and services to virtually every type of healthcare setting and provider outside of the traditional hospital. These markets – often referred to as Alternate Care or Non-Acute Care – include physician offices, surgery centers, long-term care providers, laboratories, home health and hospice agencies, health systems, government facilities and online marketplaces and retailers. Alternate Care markets are growing rapidly, and MMS is proud to be a leader in this space. newJobs.title: Chief Architect
newJobs.descriptionText: Yahoo Mail is the ultimate consumer inbox with hundreds of millions of users. It’s the best way to access your email and stay organized from a computer, phone or tablet. With its beautiful design and lightning fast speed, Yahoo Mail makes reading, organizing, and sending emails easier than ever. A Little About Us Yahoo Mail is the second largest email provider in the world, serving hundreds of millions of users at staggering scale. We are undergoing a massive Digital Transformation, moving toward an AI-native and Agentic future. This role is the technical North Star for that journey, defining how we architect systems that are not just "cloud-native," but "AI-first." Responsibilities Strategic Architecture & AI Transformation: Own the 3–5 year vision for Yahoo Mail. Lead the transition from deterministic legacy systems to non-deterministic, agentic architectures, ensuring that AI is woven into the fabric of our storage, search, and delivery layers. Internet-Scale Systems Design: Architect distributed systems handling billions of daily events. Optimize high-scale data pipelines to support real-time RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) and agentic reasoning at the edge. AI-Augmented Engineering Excellence: Define the standards for AI-assisted engineering across the organization. Proactively identify opportunities to replace manual architectural bottlenecks with AI-driven automation, from code generation to automated root-cause analysis of system failures. Technical Governance & AI Oversight: Chair architecture reviews. Establish the rigorous validation frameworks required to ensure AI-generated architectural patterns meet Yahoo’s standards for security, cost-efficiency, and 99.99% availability. Executive Influence: Act as a trusted advisor to the ELT. Frame technical investments not just as "infrastructure builds," but as "capability accelerators" driven by AI-augmented oversight. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s or Master's degree in Computer Engineering or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 15+ years of engineering experience, with a track record of leading architecture for systems with 100M+ users. 3-5+ years of experience leading AI/LLM-led transformations, specifically in moving large-scale enterprises toward agentic or autonomous system behaviors. Deep expertise in managing the intersection of traditional distributed systems and AI platforms (e.g., Vertex AI, SageMaker, or custom LLM orchestration). A commitment to experimentation with AI-driven developer productivity tools (e.g., Copilot, Cursor) to lead the organization by example. Demonstrated ability to influence at the VP/SVP level and represent Yahoo in external technical forums. Preferred Qualifications Experience with multi-cloud resiliency for AI workloads. Expertise in prompt engineering for complex system diagnostics and the governance of AI-agent permissions within a regulated environment. The material job duties and responsibilities of this role include those listed above as well as adhering to Yahoo policies; exercising sound judgment; working effectively, safely and inclusively with others; exhibiting trustworthiness and meeting expectations; and safeguarding business operations and brand integrity. At Yahoo, we offer flexible hybrid work options that our employees love! While most roles don’t require regular office attendance, you may occasionally be asked to attend in-person events or team sessions. You’ll always get notice to make arrangements. Your recruiter will let you know if a specific job requires regular attendance at a Yahoo office or facility. If you have any questions about how this applies to the role, just ask the recruiter! Yahoo is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

Our comprehensive care program takes a profoundly personal, evidence-based approach to improving patient outcomes for joint, back, and muscle conditions. By carefully assessing patients' symptoms, health histories, preferences, and goals with predictive data and the latest evidence-based guidelines, we help patients choose and navigate the most effective treatment pathway for them every step of the way. TailorCare values the experiences and perspectives of individuals from all backgrounds. We are a highly collaborative, curious, and determined team passionate about scaling a high-growth start-up to improve the lives of those in pain. TailorCare is a remote-first company with our corporate office located in Nashville. About the Role As a Care Advocate, you will be responsible for engaging prospective patients through proactive outbound calls and multichannel outreach to drive awareness and enrollment in TailorCare’s musculoskeletal (MSK) care navigation program. You’ll often serve as the first point of contact, guiding patients through the value of our services and creating a personalized, empathetic, and compelling experience. This is a high-volume, outbound call center role focused on healthcare engagement, where you will connect with patients and their caregivers to identify barriers and motivate them to take action toward improved musculoskeletal (MSK) care. This is a non-exempt (hourly) position. Location & Schedule This is a 100% remote role. Candidates must be available to work hours aligned with Eastern, Central, or Mountain Time Zones. Responsibilities Conduct high-volume outbound calls and multichannel outreach (phone, SMS, email) to eligible patients to introduce TailorCare’s services and support program enrollment. Build and maintain a working knowledge of TailorCare’s MSK program, including core conditions, care pathways, eligibility criteria, and the enrollment process, to explain the program clearly and accurately. Clearly and empathetically communicate TailorCare’s value proposition, tailoring the conversation to patient goals, health literacy, concerns, and motivations. Build trust and rapport quickly using active listening, genuine empathy, and a compassionate approach that puts patients at ease and encourages engagement. Develop and apply foundational motivational interviewing (MI) techniques — including open-ended questioning, affirmations, reflective listening, and summarizing — to support patient-centered conversations. Identify and address common patient questions, barriers, or objections using established techniques while maintaining a calm, supportive tone; seek guidance and escalate appropriately when patient needs or situations fall outside your scope. Demonstrate empathy, professionalism, and consistency across all patient interactions, representing TailorCare’s values and mission. Document all patient interactions accurately, thoroughly, and in a timely manner within internal systems to support care coordination, data integrity, and reporting. Meet or exceed performance targets related to outreach volume, patient engagement, caseload management, and call quality. Use personal performance data and coaching feedback to identify trends in your own outreach and drive continuous self-improvement. Use AI-enabled tools and new technologies with curiosity, openness, and responsibility to improve personal productivity and outreach effectiveness. Adapt to changing scripts, tools, and workflows with a positive, growth-oriented mindset. Coordinate patient handoffs with internal care teams. Participate in regular team meetings and daily standups, contributing to a positive, inclusive culture of learning and collaboration. Surface observations, feedback, and ideas on patient trends, outreach barriers, or script effectiveness to appropriate team members for continuous improvement. Perform other duties as assigned. Qualifications Required: Experience in outbound call center, inside sales, telephonic outreach, or patient engagement roles—preferably in a healthcare, health plan, or health tech environment. Strong written and verbal communication, persuasion, and active listening skills. Willingness to learn and apply motivational interviewing techniques in patient conversations. Ability to manage a high call volume while maintaining accuracy and empathy. Comfortable working with productivity targets and quality metrics in a fast-paced, tech-enabled environment. Ability to use personal performance data and feedback to drive self-improvement. High comfort level with technology, including contact center platforms, CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), documentation tools, and Google Suite. Openness and adaptability to new technologies, including responsible use of AI-enabled tools. Ability to effectively collaborate with multidisciplinary teams. Excellent organizational and prioritization skills. Strong attention to detail. Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% as needed for onsite meetings, team collaboration, and company events. Preferred: Familiarity with motivational interviewing and/or patient coaching strategies. Experience working with Medicare populations and a basic understanding of Medicare Health Plans. Knowledge of medical terminology. Previous experience with remote/telemedicine care delivery. Work Environment: We operate as a remote-first company with options for a hybrid work model in Nashville. Time Off: Our generous paid time off (PTO) and holiday plans ensure you have ample time to rest and recharge. Family First: We offer paid parental leave and support a healthy work-life balance, encouraging flexibility and autonomy. We love talking about our family and pets! Fair Compensation: We are committed to equitable pay for all team members and support your future goals with a 401k plan that includes employer matching. Community: We foster an inclusive environment where you can rely on your teammates, share honest feedback, and feel comfortable being your authentic self at work each day. newJobs.descriptionText: Lead Systems Analyst - Remote Towson, MD, USA Come make the world and accelerate your success. It takes great people to achieve greatness. People with a sense of purpose and integrity. People with a relentless pursuit of excellence. People who care about making things better For Those Who Make The World™. Sound like you? Join our top-notch team of approximately 43,500 diverse and high-performing professionals globally who are making their mark on some of the world’s most beloved brands, including DEWALT®, BLACK+DECKER®, CRAFTSMAN®, STANLEY®, CUB CADET®, and HUSTLER®. The Job: As a Lead Systems Analyst, you’ll be part of our IT – Supply Chain team working as a remote employee. You’ll get to: Serve as the functional/technical lead for the Procurement technology product area, partnering with Procurement Business Process Owners to define vision, roadmap, and measurable outcomes (cycle time, compliance, touchless processing, supplier enablement). Own and maintain the product backlog (features/user stories), including prioritization, refinement, and alignment to business value and capacity. Lead discovery and solution shaping for S2C and P2P initiatives; drive decisions across process standardization vs. local variation. Drive AI and automation initiatives across S2C and P2P to improve user experience, increase compliance, reduce cycle times, and enable touchless processing (e.g., workflow automation, intelligent intake, guided buying, PO/PR/invoice automation, and spend/supplier insights). Act as the project functional/technical lead for implementations, rollouts, and major enhancements (global/regional), coordinating requirements, design, testing, cutover, and adoption. Lead cross-functional workshops to define future-state processes and confirm impacts across Procurement, Finance/AP, and upstream/downstream systems. Manage functional risks, dependencies, and scope trade-offs; ensure delivery quality and readiness. Own end-to-end requirements: business requirements, functional specifications, process flows, control requirements, and acceptance criteria. Design and standardize processes across:S2C: sourcing events, supplier onboarding/qualification, supplier lifecycle management, contract authoring/approvals, contract repository, and compliance workflows. P2P: catalogs/guided buying, requisitioning, approvals, PO lifecycle, receiving, invoicing, matching, exceptions, and supplier enablement. Ensure solutions support auditability and key controls (e.g., approval traceability, delegation, tolerance rules, segregation of duties, retention). Provide functional oversight for configuration of Ariba (or similar) modules and related workflows, catalogs, and supplier enablement settings. Lead functional definition for integrations between the S2P suite and multiple ERPs (SAP, Infor, QAD, JDE), including: Supplier/master data synchronization and POs, receipts, invoices, status updates and exceptions Partner with integration teams (iPaaS/ESB/API) and data/BI teams to validate mappings, reconciliation, and reporting needs (spend, compliance, operational KPIs). Typical Systems & Modules in Scope S2C: sourcing, supplier lifecycle/onboarding, contract lifecycle management (CLM), approvals, compliance P2P: catalogs/guided buying, requisitions, approvals, PO management, receiving, invoicing/e-invoicing, matching, exceptions ERP integration: SAP, Infor, QAD, JDE (multi-ERP operating model) Reporting: spend analytics, compliance, cycle time, exception, aging Integration protocols: APIs, EDI, cXML, ETL processes The Person: You love to learn and grow and be acknowledged for your valuable contributions. You’re not intimidated by innovation. Wouldn’t it be great if you could do your job and do a world of good? In fact, you embrace it. You also have: Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Supply Chain, Finance, or equivalent experience. 8+ years of functional/technical experience sitting at the intersection of enterprise business system analysis and tech procurement pipelines supporting enterprise applications. 2+ years Low-Code/No-Code hands-on experience building, deploying, and maintaining production-ready low-code applications and automated workflows Hands-on experience with S2P Platforms like SAP Ariba/GEP/Coupa/Ivalua or similar platforms across S2C and/or P2P modules. Experience integrating S2P tools with SAP, Infor, QAD, and/or JD Edwards (including master data and transactional flows). Familiarity with agile delivery and tooling (Jira/Azure DevOps) and ITSM (ServiceNow). Experience with global template design, regional rollouts, and change management/adoption. Strong SQL/data validation skills and familiarity with BI tools (Power BI/Tableau). Strong experience translating business needs into epics/features/user stories and functional specifications. Proven leadership in testing and release readiness (UAT leadership, defect triage, go-live/hypercare). The Details: You’ll receive a competitive salary and a great benefits plan, including: Medical, dental, life, vision, disability, 401(k), Employee Stock Purchase Plan, paid time off, and tuition reimbursement in addition to programs & benefits in support of your well-being. Discounts on Stanley Black & Decker tools and other partner programs. And More: We want our company to be a place you’ll want to be – and stay. Being part of our team means you’ll get to: Grow: Be part of our global company with 20+ brands to grow and develop your skills along multiple career paths. Learn: Have access to a wealth of learning resources, including our digital learning portal. Belong: Experience an awesome place to work, where we have mutual respect and a great appreciation for a wide range of perspectives and experiences. Give Back: Help us continue to make positive changes locally and globally through volunteerism, giving back, and sustainable business practices. What’s more, you’ll get that pride that comes from empowering makers, doers, protectors, and everyday heroes all over the world. We’re more than the #1 tools company. More than a driving force in outdoor power equipment. More than a global leader in industrial. We’re visionaries and innovators. As successful as we’ve been in the past, we have so much further to go. That’s where you come in. Join us! By joining our growing team at Sarah Cannon Research Institute (SCRI), a subsidiary of McKesson, you will have the opportunity to become part of one of the largest community-based cancer programs to advance oncology treatments and improve outcomes for cancer patients across the globe. We look for mission-driven candidates who have a desire to advance the fight against cancer and make a difference in the lives of patients diagnosed with cancer every day. Our Mission People who live with cancer – those who work to prevent it, fight it, and survive it – are at the heart of every decision we make. Bringing the most innovative medical minds together with the most passionate caregivers in their communities, we are transforming care and personalizing treatment. Through clinical excellence and cutting-edge research, SCRI is redefining cancer care around the world. The Data Coordinator provides support to Study Coordinator on a daily basis, ensures all activities are conducted according to company standard operating procedures (SOPs) and all applicable Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and ICH regulations and guidelines. You will support the Study Coordinator to meet industry trial data deadlines You will obtain source documentation for patients enrolled into clinical trial You will assist the Study Coordinator with case report form completion and query resolution You will assist in Serious Adverse Event (SAE) reporting and tracking You will create and maintain patient visit tracking spreadsheets for the Study Coordinator You will maintain and archive study administrative files You will be assigned special procedural projects to enhance the functioning of Drug Development Data Operations Throughout the conduct of the clinical trial you will assess adherence to SCRI SOPS, Good Clinical Practice (GCP) and ICH regulations and guidelines What you should have for this role: Knowledge of scientific, medical, and regulatory terms Knowledge of GCP and Good Manufacturing Practice (GMP) Detail-oriented Excellent English written and oral skills. Focused on advancing therapies for patients over the last three decades, SCRI is a leader in drug development. In 2022, SCRI formed a joint venture with former US Oncology Research to expand clinical trial access across the country. It has conducted more than 850 first-in-human clinical trials since its inception and contributed to pivotal research that has led to the majority of new cancer therapies approved by the FDA in the past decade. SCRI’s research network brings together more than 1,300 physicians who are enrolling patients into clinical trials at more than 200 locations in 20+ states across the U.S. Please click here to learn more about our research offerings. This is determined by several factors, including performance, experience and skills, equity, regular job market evaluations, and geographical markets. In addition to base pay, other compensation, such as an annual bonus or long-term incentive opportunities may be offered. newJobs.descriptionText: TELUS Health is empowering every person to live their healthiest life. Guided by our vision, we are leveraging the power of our leading edge technology and focusing on the uniqueness of each individual to create the future of health. As a global-leading health and well-being provider – encompassing physical, mental and financial health – TELUS Health is improving health outcomes for consumers, patients, healthcare professionals, employers and employees. Our Team and What We'll Accomplish Together At TELUS Health, we're on a mission to deliver the most comprehensive and compassionate health experiences in the world — and our Proposal & Bid Management team plays a critical role in bringing that vision to life. We are a collaborative, high-performing group of strategic thinkers dedicated to crafting compelling, client-centred proposals that open doors to meaningful partnerships and drive growth across our health solutions portfolio. As a Senior Proposal Manager, you will be a strategic leader and trusted advisor within our proposal development engine — guiding complex, high-value bids from RFP receipt through to final submission. Together, we'll build persuasive, compliant, and strategically aligned proposals that reflect TELUS Health's commitment to innovation and excellence. You'll mentor junior team members, work alongside sales, subject matter experts, legal, finance, marketing, and HR to tell our story in a way that resonates with clients and wins transformational business. What You'll Do Lead and mentor the proposal team, fostering a collaborative, motivated environment while developing junior proposal professionals. Manage complex, high-value proposal processes from start to finish — ensuring compliance with RFP requirements, strategic alignment, and flawless execution on large bids ($10M+). Develop compelling, persuasive content tailored to specific client audiences, simplifying complex technical information while maintaining key messages and strategic win themes. Interview subject matter experts to gather technical content, then translate and synthesize that information into clear, digestible proposals for non-expert audiences. Create and oversee proposal strategy, compliance matrices, templates, and governance processes that ensure consistency and quality across all submissions. Lead formal proposal review meetings (pink, red, gold), providing critical feedback and ensuring all submissions are error-free, on-brand, and strategically sound. Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders (SAM leads, SMEs, Legal, Finance, HR, Marketing) to align proposal narratives with business objectives and client needs. Conduct post-submission debriefs, gather client feedback, and drive continuous improvement initiatives and lessons learned workshops. What You Bring A minimum of 5 years of direct proposal management experience, with proven success managing complex, high-value bids ($10M+) in larger organizations. A Bachelor's degree in English, Communications, or a related field — or 8+ years of equivalent professional experience. Expertise in content writing — you create clear, compelling, and persuasive content tailored to specific audiences and client needs. Meticulous attention to detail with a track record of delivering error-free, high-quality submissions under tight deadlines. Advanced proficiency in APA and Chicago style guidelines, with a thorough understanding of writing standards and best practices. Proven project management skills managing multiple complex proposals simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting aggressive deadlines. Solutions-oriented mindset — you foster a collaborative team environment. Advanced communication skills — you clearly convey complex information both verbally and in writing, and excel at stakeholder management. Great-to-Haves Certified Proposal Manager (CPM) through APMP or equivalent certification Experience with proposal management software and advanced design tools Background in healthcare, benefits, or enterprise technology sectors Track record of winning high-value bids and managing post-award transitions Mentoring or leadership experience in proposal teams Experience with visual design and data visualization to enhance proposal impact A bit about us We’re a people-focused, customer-first, purpose-driven team who works together every day to innovate and do good. TELUS is proud to foster an inclusive culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to fair employment practices and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment. We offer accommodation for applicants with disabilities, as required, during the recruitment process. By applying to this role, you understand and agree that your information will be shared with the TELUS Group of Companies’ Talent Acquisition team(s) and/or any leader(s) who will be part of the selection process.
